ftp_enabled.description: Enable the standard FTP service (port 21) managed by inetd/in.ftpd

ftps_enabled.description: Enable FTPS (FTP over TLS) — requires a dedicated FTPS-capable server like gssftpd; inetd does not handle FTP control connection encryption natively

ftp_user.description: User account under which the FTP server process runs

ftp_server_path.description: Path to the FTP server executable (inetd-compatible FTP daemon)

ftp_server_args.description: Arguments passed to the FTP server on startup (e.g., '-l' enables syslog logging, '-a' enables anonymous access)

ftp_port.description: Port number for FTP service (must be 21 for standard FTP)
